minor.issue: Auto-picks by rate = redemptions/impressions but if a variant received redemptions via direct variant_id posts BEFORE any public GET impressions, its denominator is 0 and rate=0. In practice public traffic always hits GET first, but the test needed to warm impressions via ?v= override. Consider using redemption count as fallback tiebreaker when both variants have 0 impressions.

issues: The 'Points per $ spent' input is inside a grid-cols-3 but only occupies col 1 — the other 2 cells are empty. Consider expanding or filling with additional config (e.g., 'Reward expiry days' or 'Signup bonus points').
No visual sorting by threshold — users can add tiers out of order and the tier engine sorts internally but the UI list stays in insertion order which is confusing.

action_items: OPTIONAL: fallback tiebreaker in promote-auto when all variants have 0 impressions — currently first variant wins arbitrarily.
OPTIONAL: sort tiers by threshold in Rewards UI on save + on render for consistency.
OPTIONAL: allow toggling loyalty-enabled off from Rewards UI (Switch works, but saving with enabled=false should also be visually confirmed — currently no test covers that path).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1147 lines — approaching but under the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, coupons, public, ai, growth, loyalty) before adding another feature.
public_coupon() increments stats.impressions AND variants.$.impressions on every hit including bot/health-check pings; same concern as iter 2 for stats accuracy.
public_redeem() customer identifier is truncated to 120 chars but not validated as an email nor hashed — PII lives in db.loyalty_members and db.redemptions in cleartext.

promote_experiment() auto-pick rate function: `redemptions / impressions if imp else 0` — variants with redemptions but 0 impressions get rate=0 and can lose to a variant with impressions=1, redemptions=0 (rate=0 too). Deterministic first-max is used, which is stable but not fair.

twilio_client is instantiated at module load; if TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID is added to .env, backend must be restarted (hot reload will re-import). Consider lazy client construction inside send_coupon_message for cleaner dev flow.
LoyaltyConfigIn.tiers is optional but no validation on threshold being non-negative or names being unique; UI addTier() sets threshold=0 by default which shadows Bronze.

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 iter3 + 20/20 iter2 regression endpoints all pass)
